response: If the operator switches to the imperial system on the HMI, the PLC feed readings will be affected because the feed is expressed in thousandths of an inch in the metric system but in hundred thousandths of an inch in the imperial system. Here is the impact and necessary conversions: 1. **Impact on PLC readings**: - In the metric system, feed is expressed in thousandths of a millimeter (mm).    - In the imperial system, the advance is expressed in hundred thousandths of an inch (in).  2. **Applied conversions**: - **From thousandths of mm to hundred thousandths of in**: \[ \text{Advance in hundred thousandths of in} = \frac{\text{Advance in thousandths of mm}}{25.4} \] - **From hundred thousandths of in to thousandths of mm**: \[ \text{Advance in thousandths of mm} = \text{Advance in one hundred thousandths of in} \times 25.4 \] ### Conversion Example Suppose that the lead in the metric system is \( 10000 \) thousandths of mm: \[ \text{Advance in one hundred thousandths of in} = \frac{10000}{25.4} \approx 393.70 \] In the imperial system, the lead will be read as \( 393.70 \) hundred thousandths of an inch.  ### Update Process in HMI 1. **Read the current feed of the PLC**: - Suppose that the feed is \( 10000 \) thousandths of mm.  2. **Convert to hundred thousandths of an inch**: - \( \text{Advance in hundred thousandths of an inch} = \frac{10000}{25.4} \approx 393.70 \) 3. **Update the HMI interface**: - Show the advance in HMI

By following these steps, you will be able to diagnose and resolve effectively

retrieved_contexts: ['[Fuente: Manual 8 | Página: X | Sección: 11| Título: X] En este proceso debe tenerse en cuenta el tipo de máquina de la que se dispone. En general, una máquina tándem posee frecuencia de resonancia baja; por lo tanto, el CNC debe generar consignas de posición sin componentes frecuenciales superiores a la frecuencia de resonancia. Es recomendable iniciar el proceso con valores de jerk bajos (menores de 10 m/sg3) y Kv baja. Siempre es posible aumentarlos en un reajuste posterior.
